title: Ada and the Sigil
author: Zephyrine Quintana
blurb: Gideon Almeida, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
